title: Ububiko bw' Indirimbo
search: Shakisha umutwe, umuhanzi, alubumu cyangwa injyana
selectAll: Hitamo indirimbo zose ziri kuri uru rupapuro
confirmDeleteOne: Gusiba indirimbo “{{title}}” n'ibijyanye nayo kuri seriveri.
emptyBody: Shyiraho indirimbo za mbere kugira ngo utangire ububiko bwa radiyo.

upload.title: Shyiraho indirimbo
upload.subtitle: Ongera indirimbo mu bubiko bw'iyi sitidiyo. Zihita zitunganyirizwa gucurangwa kuri radiyo.
upload.dropTitle: Kurura amajwi uyashyire hano, cyangwa ukande uhitemo
upload.dropHint: Ushobora guhitamo amajwi menshi icyarimwe (kugeza kuri {{batch}} ni byiza)

warnings.largeBatch: Hari amajwi {{count}} ku rutonde. Kohereza {{batch}} cyangwa munsi yayo byoroshye gukurikirana no gusubukura iyo interineti icitse.
warnings.largeFiles_one: Ijwi {{count}} rirengeje {{size}}. Rizoherezwa ariko bizatinda. Byaba byiza urisohoye nka MP3 cyangwa FLAC aho kuba WAV.
warnings.largeFiles_other: Amajwi {{count}} arengeje {{size}}. Azoherezwa ariko bizatinda. Byaba byiza uyasohoye nka MP3 cyangwa FLAC aho kuba WAV.

errors.finalize: Ijwi ryoherejwe ariko ntiryashoboye gushyirwa ku murongo wo gutunganywa.

formats.title: Ubwoko
formats.body: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A cyangwa OGG; byiza ni 192 kbps+ cyangwa lossless. Bihindurwa MP3 ya {{kbps}} kbps.

batch.title: Umubare
batch.body: Kugeza ku majwi {{batch}}, buri rimwe munsi ya {{size}}; {{concurrency}} yoherezwa icyarimwe.

tags.title: Amakuru
tags.body: Umutwe, umuhanzi na alubumu bisomwa mu makuru y'ijwi (tags); volume iringanizwa ubwayo.

connection.title: Guma hano
connection.body: Ntufunge iri dirishya kugeza byose birangiye; ongera ugerageze ibyanze. Indirimbo ziba ziteguye nyuma y’iminota mike.
